name: 蒂埃里·查夫里穆图
name_full: 蒂埃里·查夫里穆图 Thierry Chavrimootoo
introduction: Best known for his gritty and dark style of storytelling, Director/Screenwriter Thierry Chavrimootoo first established his style and trademark through his music videos, documentaries and short films. He later went on to direct, write and co produce his first feature film Imperative (2021) and founded his production company visage cinema ltd in 2020.
